drafts.walkScript: Read both clues. Finn is faster than Isla, and Isla is faster than Ben. So from fastest to slowest the order is Finn, Isla, Ben. Ben is the slowest. Isla is faster than Ben, and Finn is the fastest.

Read both clues. Jack is taller than Cara, and Cara is taller than Finn. So from tallest to shortest the order is Jack, Cara, Finn. Finn is the shortest. Cara is taller than Finn, and Jack is the tallest.
Read both clues. Ella is faster than Hari, and Hari is faster than Amy. So from fastest to slowest the order is Ella, Hari, Amy. Ella is the fastest. Hari comes second, and Amy is the slowest.
